validity.recommendation: No action needed on existence/duplicate/attribution. This is a real, actively-developed offtake pipeline, well documented across a federal legal decree, a state environmental review, a municipal engineering design filing, and independent regional press spanning 2022-2023. Not a duplicate of siblings P4085 (Olonets-Pitkyaranta, decree item 46) or P4093 (Ikhala-Sortavala, decree item 47) -- each is a physically distinct offtake/GRS pair serving a different part of the same Northern Priladozhye gasification cluster, confirmed by the same government.ru decree listing them as separate numbered items with separate routes and separate capacities, and by mrg.gazprom.ru's press release distinguishing this object ('Газопровод-отвод и ГРС Ихала', Leningrad Oblast to Lakhdenpokhsky District) from the two inter-settlement distribution branches it built alongside it ('ГРС Ихала-г.Лахденпохья...' 32.9km and 'ГРС Сортавала-п.Рауталахти...' 37.1km).
validity.researcher_notes: Existence and identity confirmed independently of GEM via four distinct institutional origins: (1) a federal government territorial-planning decree (government.ru, Order 816-r schedule of trunk gas pipelines, item 45) naming this exact object, route and capacity; (2) a Rosprirodnadzor State Ecological Expert Review registry entry (positive, issued 10-Feb-2023, client Gazprom Mezhregiongaz); (3) a municipal (Kuznechnoye rural settlement, Priozersky District, Leningrad Oblast) engineering design document set (tom_1/5/6.pdf) giving full route, length, diameter, pressure and classification detail; (4) independent regional/operator press (mrg.gazprom.ru Apr-2023, its gazpromgr-karelia.ru/ptzgovorit.ru reprints, and rk.karelia.ru's 2022 and 2023 coverage). THREE CAVEATS surfaced during this sweep and filed as separate concern records / notes: (a) a genuine classification tension (distribution per functional/institutional evidence vs. the primary engineering document's explicit 'магистральный газопровод'/trunk labeling) -- see the 'classification' concern record; (b) a ~2.8% Length discrepancy between the primary engineering document (114.5 km, matching the sheet exactly) and a cluster of same-origin press releases (111.3 km) -- see the 'spec' concern record; (c) credible but not-currently-citable evidence (a Sept-2024 Rostekhnadzor public-hearing presentation I personally read but could not re-locate a stable URL for in this pass) that construction is now actively underway, which would make the sheet's current Status=proposed stale -- filed as an 'unclear'-verdict status_reviews[] entry rather than either silently confirming or fabricating a citation.

validity.recommendation: Have a human weigh the primary engineering document's explicit trunk-pipeline ('магистральный газопровод') classification against the functional/institutional case for 'distribution' laid out in the PipelineType fill. Russian engineering usage of 'магистральный' is often a pipe-design/construction-code category (diameter/pressure/class-based, per SNiP 2.05.06-85) rather than GEM's functional transmission-vs-distribution split, which leans this sweep toward keeping 'distribution' -- but the document uses the term as a section heading for the object's own design spec (Class I / Category IV), which is a more direct classification claim than this sweep is fully comfortable overriding unilaterally.
validity.researcher_notes: The kuznechnoe.lenobl.ru tom_1.pdf engineering design document contains a dedicated section headed 'Проектируемый магистральный газопровод' (Trunk gas pipeline under design) giving this exact object's diameter (325mm), pressure (up to 5.5 MPa), 'класс-I; категория-IV' pipe classification, and design gas-transport volume (30.245 million m3/year) -- i.e., it labels THIS object, not some other pipeline, a магистральный (trunk/main) gas pipeline. Weighed against this: the object's stated purpose (decree: 'обеспечение потребителей природного газа' -- supplying gas consumers), its administration under a named regional GASIFICATION programme (mrg.gazprom.ru: 'Программа развития газоснабжения и газификации Республики Карелия'), and its ownership/client chain running through Gazprom's DISTRIBUTION-side subsidiaries (Gazprom Mezhregiongaz as GEE client; Gazprom Gazoraspredelenie Petrozavodsk as the entity presenting its construction status). Not treating this as a settled fact either way -- filing as a concern for human judgment rather than silently keeping 'distribution' or silently flipping to 'transmission'.
